arXiv — RynnVLA-001: Using Human Demonstrations to Improve Robot Manipulation: This paper presents RynnVLA-001, a vision-language-action(VLA) model built upon large-scale video generative pretraining from human demonstrations. We propose a novel two-stage pretraining methodology.
